states.text:
01 / CAPTURE
A useful starting point.

An example website enquiry enters the workflow with the context your team needs.

“We’d like to discuss automating our sales enquiries.”

Synthetic example. No customer data is collected.

02 / UNDERSTAND
Make the next step clearer.

AI suggests an enquiry category using your agreed rules. Uncertain requests stay in a review queue.

Suggested category: Automation project

AI suggestions need evaluation and human oversight.

03 / CONNECT
Bring the context together.

A proposed CRM record carries the enquiry and suggested category forward, subject to agreed permissions.

Example record · New project · Needs review

Illustration only. No CRM is connected to this demo.

04 / ASSIST
Keep people in control.

Your team reviews a suggested reply and decides what to send. Nothing is sent automatically in this example.

Draft: Let’s discuss your workflow and priorities.

Human approval before customer-facing messages.
